transcript.text: Dr. Morgan, I need to report a site safety issue. Yesterday, after the draft plan was circulated, I received the soil test results from the proposed garden area. The lab measured lead at 180 parts per million. Our district garden standard requires removing the top six inches of soil and using raised beds at that reading. This means the current draft plan's use of in-ground beds would not meet the district standard, and I have not yet entered this result into the project folder.
